entities.name: Esmail Momtaz od-Dowleh
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Esmail Momtaz od-Dowleh was a notable Iranian statesman of the early twentieth century. Born in Tehran in 1880, he was one of the original Parliamentarians of the First Majles in 1906. He was also its fourth Speaker.
